watch.readinessNote: Hypixel publishes every Hytale server build as com.hypixel.hytale:Server in its own Maven repository; the release repository carries the builds players get. The connector is a Java plugin built against that server API, and the API still changes between Hytale updates, so every new server version needs a rebuild and a live retest before it is declared.

plugin.description: The Takaro plugin jar, copied into the server's mods/ folder. It holds the Takaro connection itself; no sidecar
